topic: 专项练习 - 动名词与动词不定式 (Gerunds and Infinitives)

questions.question: My younger sister really enjoys ______ mysteries before going to bed.
questions.explanation: enjoy 后面必须接动名词作宾语，即 enjoy doing sth.，因此选择 reading。

questions.question: After discussing for an hour, our team decided ______ the science project together.
questions.explanation: decide 后面通常接不定式作宾语，固定搭配为 decide to do sth.，因此选 to complete。

questions.question: All the students are looking forward to ______ the natural history museum next Friday.
questions.explanation: look forward to 中的 to 是介词，后面必须跟名词或动名词（doing），因此选 visiting。

questions.question: Leo was exhausted after the marathon, so he stopped ______ under a big oak tree.
questions.explanation: stop to do 表示“停下手中的事去做另一件事”；stop doing 表示“停止正在做的事”。句意是他太累了，所以停下来去休息，故用 to rest。

questions.question: The library is quiet. Please stop ______ loudly with your classmates.
questions.explanation: 图书馆需要安静，因此是要求“停止正在大声说话的行为”，stop doing sth. 表示停止正在做的事，选 talking。

questions.question: If you want to play the piano well, you must practise ______ scales every single day.
questions.explanation: practise 后面固定接动名词作宾语，即 practise doing sth.，故选 playing。

questions.question: The naughty puppy refused ______ into the bathtub for a wash.
questions.explanation: refuse 后接动词不定式做宾语，构成 refuse to do sth.（拒绝做某事），故选 to jump。

questions.question: Emily is extremely good at ______ chess and has won several school trophies.
questions.explanation: be good at 结构中 at 为介词，介词后接动词必须使用动名词形式（-ing），故选 playing。

questions.question: Please remember ______ off the classroom lights before leaving for the weekend.
questions.explanation: remember to do sth. 表示“记着去做某事（事情尚未做）”；remember doing sth. 表示“记得做过某事”。此处是提醒离校前记得关灯，故选 to turn。

questions.question: I clearly remember ______ the front door this morning; I definitely turned the key twice.
questions.explanation: 根据后半句“我确实转了两圈钥匙”，说明关门锁门是已经发生过的事。remember doing sth. 表示记得做过某事，故选 locking。

questions.question: ______ regularly is one of the healthiest habits a person can develop.
questions.explanation: 动名词短语可在句中作主语，表示一种经常性的抽象行为。此处 Exercising regularly 作主语，故选 B。

questions.question: Sophia hopes ______ an astronaut and travel to Mars in the future.
questions.explanation: hope 后面只能接不定式作宾语，即 hope to do sth.，不能接 hope sb. to do 或 hope doing，故选 to become。

questions.question: You should avoid ______ sweet beverages right before going to sleep.
questions.explanation: avoid 意为“避免”，后面只能接动名词作宾语，即 avoid doing sth.，故选 drinking。

questions.question: Jack promised ______ me with my math homework as soon as he finished his dinner.
questions.explanation: promise 后面接动词不定式作宾语，固定搭配 promise to do sth.（答应做某事），故选 to help。

questions.question: Our art teacher suggested ______ recycled cardboard to build the model city.
questions.explanation: suggest 后面接动词时，必须使用动名词形式 suggest doing sth.（严禁使用 suggest to do），故选 using。

questions.question: Don't forget ______ your student ID card tomorrow morning; the security guard will check it.
questions.explanation: forget to do sth. 表示“忘记去做某事（事情还没做）”；forget doing sth. 表示“忘记曾经做过某事”。此处提醒明天不要忘记带证件，故选 to bring。

questions.question: Grandpa will never forget ______ the giant panda in the wild when he was young.
questions.explanation: 这里指年轻时亲眼见过大熊猫的难忘经历，表示已经经历过的事，用 forget doing sth.，故选 seeing。

questions.question: Would you like ______ the robotics club with me this semester?
questions.explanation: 固定句型 would like to do sth. 意为“想要做某事”，注意与 like doing（常规爱好）区分，故选 to join。

questions.question: Would you mind ______ the window? It is getting rather windy outside.
questions.explanation: mind 作为动词表示“介意”，后面只能接动名词做宾语，即 would you mind doing sth.?，故选 closing。

questions.question: As soon as Maya finished ______ the essay, she handed it to the teacher.
questions.explanation: finish 后面必须接动名词作宾语，即 finish doing sth.（完成做某事），故选 writing。

questions.question: During the summer camp, we learned how ______ a safe campfire.
questions.explanation: “疑问词 + 不定式”（how to do sth.）在句中作宾语，表示“如何搭建”，故选 to build。

questions.question: Even though it started raining heavily, the gardeners kept ______ the hedges.
questions.explanation: keep doing sth. 是固定用法，意为“继续/一直做某事”，表示动作的持续性，故选 trimming。

questions.question: Seeing that the old lady had heavy groceries, kind David offered ______ them for her.
questions.explanation: offer 后面接动词不定式，构成 offer to do sth.，表示“主动提出做某事”，故选 to carry。

questions.question: The soup tastes a bit bland. You can try ______ a pinch of salt and black pepper.
questions.explanation: try doing sth. 表示“尝试一下某种方法/试试看”；try to do sth. 表示“尽力、努力去做某事”。此处指尝试放点盐看看味道如何，故选 adding。

questions.question: Thank you so much for ______ such an inspiring presentation about marine biology.
questions.explanation: 介词 for 后面要跟动名词作宾语，Thank you for doing sth. 是标准用法，故选 giving。

questions.question: It is not easy ______ fluent in a foreign language in just six months.
questions.explanation: It is + adj. + to do sth. 为固定句型，其中 It 为形式主语，真正的主语是后面的动词不定式短语 to become...，故选 B。

questions.question: We cannot afford ______ a new laptop until we save more money.
questions.explanation: afford 后面通常与 can/cannot 连用，接动词时用不定式，即 afford to do sth.（负担得起做某事），故选 to buy。

questions.question: The comedian was so hilarious that the audience couldn't help ______ throughout the show.
questions.explanation: can't help doing sth. 是固定短语，意为“忍不住/禁不住做某事”，后面必须接动名词，故选 laughing。

questions.question: Instead of ______ computer games all afternoon, Tim chose to ride his bike in the park.
questions.explanation: instead of 是介词短语，意为“代替，而不是”，其后必须接动名词形式 doing，故选 playing。

questions.question: Little Ben tried ______ the jar of strawberry jam on the top shelf, but he was not tall enough.
questions.explanation: try to do sth. 强调“努力、设法做某事（通常面临困难或未能达成）”；根据后半句“不够高”，说明他努力尝试去够但够不着，故选 to reach。
